title: dragulaR 0.3.3 (development version)
text: dragula() gains maxItems shortcut option limiting many elements container accept, e.g. dragula(c("Available", "Model"), maxItems = list(Model = 3)) (#4). new example app, example08-max-items, demonstrates . example apps published static Shinylive site runs entirely browser. tools/build-shinylive.R exports every app inst/apps/ GitHub Actions workflow deploys result GitHub Pages.

title: dragulaR 0.3.3 (development version)
text: dragulaValue() now returns character(0) empty container instead dropping result, returned list always one entry per registered container. useDragulajs() passes functions = "refreshDragulaR" shinyjs::extendShinyjs(), recent versions shinyjs require js$refreshDragulaR() defined. Calling dragula() options longer sends empty JSON array dragula JavaScript library expects options object. accepts wrapper installed maxItems longer fails dragula calls null target (element dragged outside container). JavaScript code checks registered container ids actually exist document using . Examples 02 07 call library(dragulaR); previously worked package happened attached already. Fixed runApp() paths example 07 README - directory example07-input-options.

title: dragulaR 0.3.3 (development version)
text: JS() imported htmlwidgets instead V8, dropping V8 dependency. V8::JS verbatim copy htmlwidgets::JS, -op runtime, removes compiled dependency makes package loadable webR/Shinylive, V8 WebAssembly build. Expanded test coverage dragulaValue(), copyOnly maxItems. Documentation regenerated roxygen2 8.1.0; added Encoding: UTF-8 DESCRIPTION return-value documentation exported functions. Added AGENTS.md guidelines AI agents working package.

title: dragulaR 0.3.2
text: dragula() accepts arbitrary dragula JavaScript options ..., forwarded JavaScript library (thanks Darren Maczka). id still handled Shiny input id. Added copyOnly shortcut option, makes container source elements copied rather moved , together example07-input-options app. Darren Maczka added authors list contributor.

title: dragulaR 0.2.0
text: dragula(x, id = NULL) now takes vector container ids registers single dragula instance; elements carrying drag attribute ones tracked. Added dragulaValue() turning raw input$dragula object named list container ids element order. Added useDragulajs() js$refreshDragulaR() JavaScript function refreshing dragula elements added dynamically insertUI() renderUI(). widget waits Shiny finish initialising rendering. Added example apps covering basic usage, Shiny inputs, element order, Shiny modules dynamically inserted elements. Added test suite, pkgdown site CI (Travis, AppVeyor, codecov). Updated bundled dragula JavaScript library.
